name: ai-product-catalogue-monorepo
description: AI-Native Product Catalogue MVP - Clean Architecture with React & Node.js

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend test
